text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egypt and Morocco stress their support for Palestinian people in their struggle to regain their legitimate rights. Leaders of two countries in statement after talks affirm support for peace process on bases of international resolutions.
- Financial Times newspaper says Mubarak has raised Egypt's flag on the investment map.
- Interior Minister Alfi says outlawed Brotherhood group are trying to play about with union elections. He says Egypt does not want Sheikh Omar Abdel-Rahman.
- Turkey hopes Mubarak will take part in Islamic group summit in Istanbul in June.
- Egypt and Morocco blame Israel for delay in peace talks.
- Government says it will offer land for Eygptian and foreign investors.
- Grand Sheikh of al-Azhar signs first organ donor card.
- Egypt to launch intensive contacts with parties of peace process.
- Government officials to discuss offering shares in mobile telephone company.
